translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

book.name: 1 Corintios
book.title: Kart nech daa bzej Páblona' na' bseḻeen lao beṉ'ka' nonḻilall' Jesucrístona' yell Coríntona'

content: Na' ka nak c̱he yeḻ' wawa' daa chllia beṉ' lao lwaa lsak' chios c̱he'ka', yog'cho ṉezicho c̱heyi dga. Per nxoll gakcho beṉ' cha'sib daa chakicho ḻe ṉezicho. San shi napcho yeḻ' chakina', wzecho wṉeyi gaklen ljwellcho gakchachcho.
Na' beena' chaki ḻe ṉezile', chiyaḻ' gakbe'ile' bi ṉezile' ka chiyaḻ'.
Per beena' ḻe chakile' Chioza', Chioza' nombi'ene'.
Na' ka nak yeḻ' wawa' daa chllia beṉ' lao lwaa lsak' chios c̱he'ka', ṉezicho lwaa lsak' chios c̱he'ka' bibi zak'gakan, san toz Chiozan' zoa.
Dii ḻi de dii zan daa na beṉ' nakgakan chios c̱hegake'. Per ḻa'kzi nagake' zoa chios c̱hegake' na' x̱angake' yabana' wa lo yell-lioni,

cho' ṉezicho toz Chiozan' zoa, beena' nak X̱acho. Ḻen' bx̱e bsil yog'ḻoḻte dii de, na' zoacho kwenc̱he we'la'ochone'. Na' ḻekzka' zoa toz beena' nak X̱ancho, na' ḻen' Jesucrístona', beena' bx̱e bsile' yog'ḻoḻte dii de, na' ni c̱hen' mbancho.

Per aga yog' beṉ' ṉezgakile' dga. Baḻ beṉ' wyoologake' be'la'ogake' lwaa lsak' chios c̱he'ka', na' kat' cheej chaogake' yeḻ' wawa' daa ba bllia beṉ' lawinka' chakgakile' txenan chonlengake'n. Na' daa biṉ' gakbe'gakile' bibi zakii diika', chakgakile' malan' chongake' kat' cheej chaogake' yeḻ' wawa'.
Per aga ni c̱he daa cheej chaochon ile'shi'chi Chioza' cho' wa gonile' cho' nakzi; ḻa' aga bi chon daa gaocho wa daa bi gaocho.

Per cho', ḻa'kzi chakbe'icho aga bi zakii lwaa lsak' chios c̱he'ka' na' ṉezicho aga bi nonan shi yeej gaocho diika' blliagake' lawinka', chiyaḻ' wsak'cho kwenc̱he ki wchix̱cho beena' biṉ' gakcha lo xṉez Chioza' gone' daa chakile' nakan mal.

Ḻa' shi ṉezile aga bi zakii lwaa lsak' chios c̱he'ka' na' cheej chaole gana' choe'la'ogake' ḻegakan, na' ile'i to bish' ljwell-le le', beṉ' biṉ' gakcha lo xṉez Chioza', na' nxoll wc̱hoglallee yeej gawe'n, ḻa'kzi chakile' nakan mal.
Na' daa chonle daa ṉezile bi nakan mal, nxoll wḻaale lo xṉez Chioza' bish' ljwell-lena' beena' biṉ' gakcha, beena' ḻekzka' wit Crístona' ni c̱he'.
Na' daa chonle ka gon bish' ljwell-lena' to dii na yic̱hjlall'do'ena' bi chiyaḻ' gone', lao Crístona'kzan chx̱iṉj chḻenle.
Daan shi daa cheej chaw' gonan ka wx̱iṉj wḻen bish' ljwellaa, naklan wen bichga gaw' belaa, kwenc̱he bi gon' ka wx̱iṉj wḻene'.
